morphology.compounding_rule: Hellenic [adjective|resource](stem) + feature-word with linking -o- (Melas + oros -> Melanoros) layered over Sinitic quality/feature + type compounds run through the Greek filter (Jin + cheng -> Chryskeng, golden-city; Da + jiang -> Megagian, great-river): the capital Serellis, Chryskeng (the golden walled-city), Potagian-polis (the river-city).
morphology.patronymic_form: the Hellenic ruling stock keep a patronymic -ides/-ades (son of) plus an academy/polis demonym; the Sinitic populace keep the clan-surname (xing) first plus a generation-name within a zu-lineage; the throne fuses both - a strategos who also carries a Sinitic xing-house name. Order given-first for the Greek register, surname-first for the Sinitic.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: fallen Hellenic sanctums and ruined warlord cheng along the silk-road: 'the Labyrinth of Heros Theron', 'the Ruined Keng of [warlord]', 'the Tomb of [name]'
patterns.military_units: the [Adjective] Phalanx / Lochos and the Sinitic Ying-camps and Banners: 'the Bronze Phalanx', 'the Azure Banner', 'the Strategos' Lochos'
patterns.ships: silk-road river-barges and Hellenic war-keels: 'Pride of Serellis', 'the Jade Trireme', 'Boat of Tulrios', 'the Silk-Wind'
patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]': 'The Jade Kylix', 'The Silk and Scroll', 'The Bronze Helm'

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Hellenic Greek reflexes PRIMARY (family_classical/achillean, the -os/-on/-es Hellenic forms), Sinitic celestial morphs SECONDARY (family_east_asian.json theonym_sets.sinitic), never real Greek/Chinese gods. The academy's philosophy of the One meets the celestial bureaucracy of the Mandate: the philosophers contemplate Aiternos/Aiteng the unknowable source, the mandarins serve the celestial powers as officials of Highest Heaven.
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as daimones (Hellenic demons) or the mo demon-marshals (Sinitic) outside the celestial order, keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Maraxos the Tyrant-Flame (Sinitic Maluo the War-Fire Marshal); Vacidus -> Vakidos the Void (Sinitic Wuci the Devourer); Lusanto -> Lusanthos the Hoard-Worm (Sinitic Lusan the Coin-Serpent).

holy_symbol_motifs.Gaiandros: a green mountain above the olive-branch and the grain-altar
holy_symbol_motifs.Orlandros: an iron spear crossed with an oath-ring and the city-standard
holy_symbol_motifs.Tulrios: a radiate sun-disc above the scales of justice and the seal of office

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Temenos/Mysteria (Hellenic precinct) or the Miao (Sinitic temple) of [power]: 'the Mysteries of Numenos', 'the Miao of Tuli-di'; the ancestral Ci (clan-shrine) for the zu.
religion.saints_pattern: the Heroes (deified founders and sages, venerated at a heroon tomb-shrine) and the worthy officials enrolled in the celestial register, honored at the Ci (ancestral shrine) and the miao-temple; 'Heros [name]', 'the Lord [name]'.

sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Gaiandros (Sinitic Gaidun-di) - the enduring earth, lord of mountains
sample_deity_renames.Numeno: Numenos (Sinitic Numeng-jun) - air and sage-wisdom of the winds
sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Tulrios (Sinitic Tuli-di) - the sun and justice, the Sun-Justice Emperor

religion.the_one: Aiternos (Hellenic, < Aeternus; Sinitic Aiteng, the Highest Heaven and source of the Mandate) - the One, unknowable source, honored and contemplated, not petitioned

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, and names the Lawful powers - and Aiternos/Aiteng - as the tyrant-gods of a corrupt court to be defied and overthrown.
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Aiternos contemplated, Tulrios the just, Orlandros of the sworn oath, Realtia the merciful - as the celestial officials of Highest Heaven and the patrons of the academy; the philosopher's reason and the mandarin's rite bind alike, and the Chaotic powers are named daimones (Hellenic) or the mo demon-marshals (Sinitic), warded outside the celestial order.
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: honors the deified ancestors (the Heroes of the founding houses and the zu of the lineage) and the local earth-and-grain powers and city-spirits, with the great powers invoked at the temenos-grove and the miao-temple situationally; the Confucian ancestral rite orders all.

titles._tiers_note: Hellenic ladder, ascending, with the Sinitic celestial-bureaucratic substrate co-titles fused beneath. Toparch (estate-lord) barony; Phrourarch-dudu (garrison-march-commander; Gk phrourarch + Ch dudu frontier-command) march; ARCHON (the approved foreign term, the provincial governor) county over an Archontia; Strategos (general-governor) duchy; Dynastes (prince-ruler) principality; Basileus-wang (king; Gk basileus + Ch wang) kingdom over a Basileia; Autokrator-di (emperor; Gk autokrator + Ch -di celestial-emperor) empire over the Autokratoria, holding the Mandate (Tianming) and the academy's blessing alike. The conquered cheng-cities keep their Sinitic shidafu (scholar-official) and the Confucian magistrate beneath the Hellenic crown. The hierophant-priest and the Sinitic daoshi stand outside the ladder. Rank titles fuse the real Greek and Chinese registers (allowed); only the county ruler surfaces as an approved foreign DISPLAY term (Archon).
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler' - here Archon for the county). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
titles.government: feudal (a Hellenic philosopher-aristocracy over the Sinitic river-cities and their mandarin bureaucracy: the Basileus and his strategoi at the crown, the Archon-governors over the cheng-cities, the toparch-lords on their estates; the Sinitic scholar-officials of the celestial court - the shidafu and the dudu frontier-commands - serve and administer beneath)
titles.heir: Diadochos (successor-designate; Sinitic Taizi/Shizi for a wang-heir)
